identification: layout (mod 12) + assumption that the finest visible groups are the slide's finest

ctf_fit.model: 3 bars x PSF x camera pixel, plus uniform stray light; PSF Gaussian, or a Gaussian core + wider Gaussian halo when that fits clearly better

notes: Group number assumed (finest visible pair taken as the slide's finest). Pass --pixel-size (approx. is fine) or --coarsest-group to confirm; the alternative is 2 groups coarser.
Bars reach the camera's full scale (255) in 25 element(s) (G2E1-G6E5): clipped peaks bias contrast; lower the exposure if possible.
Not measurable, cut off by the image border (stepped over): G2E3, G2E4, G2E5, G2E6
Bar sets moved to their layout position (detection was paired with another feature): G2E2 H, G6E2 H

The fitted CTF curve crosses 20% at 80.3 lp/mm, inside G6E2, while the element-by-element limit is G6E3. They can differ when elements near the threshold are within the measurement noise of it; the fit uses all elements at once.
